title: 🏫 Anime High School Life
description:
🎭 (With ACTUAL Events & Progression!)
70+ characters. 4 classes. 12 clubs. All unique. Lead your own high school life in this polished, high-effort scenario taking place in Japan!
prompt:
🌸 Welcome to your new high school life in Japan! 🌸

Before you begin, there are a few things to keep in mind:
🌙 Progress: Ready for the next day? Just type 'pass the day' or 'end the day' when you're at home or not in the middle of a conversation/scene!
🗓️ Calendar: Check your Calendar in Story Cards regularly! It automatically updates everyday with school curriculum, upcoming events, and more!

---

>Lite: Calendar System + Trimmed Context (for Free Players)

Today is Monday, April 11. The day of the entrance ceremony.

Wiping off a stray cherry blossom petal, you pass through the gates and join the current of murmuring students flowing toward a massive corkboard set up in the center of the brick courtyard. The new school year placement board.

But before you can fully process the gravity of your new high school life, the courtyard loudspeakers unleash a piercing screech of feedback.

"Ahem. Testing." A nasal, overly formal voice of echoes across the grounds. "Therefore, let us welcome the morning. Will all new first-year students please make their way to the main gymnasium immediately? Furthermore, the opening ceremony will commence in precisely ten minutes. Therefore... proceed in an orderly fashion."

The speaker crackles off, leaving a brief, stunned silence in its wake. Almost immediately, the crowd erupts into a low, buzzing murmur of disbelief.

"Was that the principal's voice?"
"Who the hell starts a morning announcement with 'Therefore'?"
"Get used to it. I got held back a year, and trust me... the number of times he says 'therefore' and 'furthermore' is higher than my actual grades."

cardPool.value:
{Character: Hatakeyama Daizen

cardPool.title: 🏫 Matsuzaki Sadao
cardPool.value:
{Character: Matsuzaki Sadao

cardPool.title: 🏫 Yukishiro Yukie
cardPool.value:
{Character: Yukishiro Yukie
Female Arts Teacher; DoB Mar 12th, slender, long wavy ash-brown hair. A brilliant artist and complete space case. She is wildly romantic, dreamy, scatterbrained, and deeply artistic. She gazes wistfully out the window mid-sentence, accidentally dips her paintbrush into her tea, and speaks in overly dramatic, poetic metaphors about the beauty of youth.}

cardPool.title: 🏫 Hasegawa Osamu

cardPool.title: 🏫🗂️ Mochizuki Shiori
cardPool.value:
{Character: Mochizuki Shiori
Female Teacher; DoB Apr 1st, petite frame, short brown hair with an ahoge, adorable face. An utter airhead and an impossibly clumsy dojikko. She is scatterbrained, energetic, somewhat annoying, and wildly disorganized. She constantly forgets she has classes, arrives horribly late, trips over flat surfaces, and loses her daily materials.}

cardPool.title: 🏫🗂️ Kurose Ryohei
cardPool.value:
{Character: Kurose Ryohei
Male Teacher; DoB Apr 9th, lanky, messy black hair, tired eyes. A fukou taishitsu whose luck is so bad it sometimes cancels itself out. He is unlucky, resilient, desensitized, and tired.
